comparison.objective: Install an oversized U-joint cross between yoke ears by inserting one journal, swinging level and recentering; candidate transfers an LM block from rail to jig.
comparison.physical_skill: Record uses an asymmetric insert–pivot–backslide sequence to place two journals in opposed holes. Candidate uses bimanual end-face mating and a continuous axial slide while preventing free balls from losing support.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires both journals inserted to similar depth, aligned and still. Candidate requires complete transfer, all four ball rows retained, no interface gap/jam/damage and released stability.
comparison.reason: This record shares constrained insertion and recentering, but it tests rigid cross geometry between opposed holes; it has no continuous support handoff or independently moving elements that can escape.
